主要内容: On August 20, 2014, Eric S. Whitaker resigned as Chief Legal Officer, Senior Vice President of Technology Licensing, and Corporate Secretary of SanDisk Corporation, effective September 5, 2014. The resignation was communicated in a letter dated August 20, 2014, by Judy Bruner, Executive Vice President, Administration and Chief Financial Officer. The resignation letter was filed as Exhibit 99.1. SanDisk Corporation announced on August 22, 2014, that Eric S. Whitaker had resigned as a key executive, effective August 20, 2014.
